affectedSurfaces: Antigravity CLI redaction-safe native command traces
Antigravity CLI native provider egress and eval-scoped auth projection
AGY model evaluation isolation and candidate execution routing
hypothesis: Persisting redaction-safe exact and prefix command fingerprints, matching effort-qualified AGY catalog entries, and chaining Antigravity's native allowlist proxy through the explicit Google-provider container proxy lets the AGY suite execute every calibrated scenario and score required and forbidden process instructions without exposing provider tool input or falling back to direct public or host execution.

metricsCompared.name: native commands available to scoring after durable redaction
metricsCompared.baseline: 0/1 production command traces survived workflow storage because provider status output was redacted before rubric evaluation
metricsCompared.candidate: 1/1 recognized command is represented by exact and prefix fingerprints that survive storage while raw command text and unrelated provider parameters remain absent
metricsCompared.unit: adapter, workflow projection, and rubric boundary assertions

metricsCompared.name: trace-backed process-instruction outcomes
metricsCompared.baseline: 0/3 trace-backed rubric cases distinguished missing required commands, forbidden Git commits, and a complete allowed trace
metricsCompared.candidate: 3/3 trace-backed rubric cases independently reject missing required evidence and a forbidden git commit, then accept the complete allowed trace

metricsCompared.name: canonical AGY scenarios reaching candidate execution after verifier calibration
metricsCompared.baseline: 0/3 scenarios reached the executor because the CLI defaulted to host subprocess and executable verifier calibration returned not-started
metricsCompared.candidate: 3/3 scenarios complete real fixture materialization and verifier calibration, then reach the executor with antigravity-cli, the requested model, and max effort

metricsCompared.name: native Antigravity provider route chained through container enforcement
metricsCompared.baseline: 0/1 native proxy routes consumed the eval-configured upstream; the inner proxy attempted direct public TCP from an internal Docker network
metricsCompared.candidate: 1/1 provider-egress marker propagates through the production container environment and Antigravity adapter, while allowed native CONNECT requests chain through the configured upstream and the marker is removed before AGY launch

metricsCompared.name: requested-model availability checked in candidate execution environment
metricsCompared.baseline: 0/1 availability probes matched the requested model and effort; a base candidate id was compared against effort-qualified container catalog entries
metricsCompared.candidate: 1/1 production availability probe launches agy models through the configured candidate container and requires the exact candidate-high catalog entry before reusing that execution runtime for all scenarios

metricsCompared.name: canonical scenarios covered by harness-wide commit instruction
metricsCompared.baseline: 2/3 scenarios declared a forbidden git commit trace rule; repair could pass after attempting a commit
metricsCompared.candidate: 3/3 scenarios inherit one harness-sourced forbidden git commit rule, and the repair rubric case rejects a traced commit attempt independently of scenario outcome

rationale: The candidate keeps raw provider tool input redacted while preserving only deterministic command fingerprints needed for exact required-command and prohibited-prefix scoring. The rubric validates the fingerprint protocol and rejects synthetic plaintext provider payloads. Host and offline requests fail before probing or fixture work; valid requests require the exact effort-qualified model catalog entry, project the configured provider proxy into KOTA's native-CLI egress seam, retain the Antigravity endpoint allowlist, and chain CONNECT through the Docker-network proxy instead of dialing public addresses. The marker is stripped before AGY launch and from KOTA-owned task subprocesses after lower-trust overlays merge; Google auth variables are projected only while this eval seam is active. Executable verifiers retain their separate offline container. Real fixture loading, verifier calibration, eval-set routing, artifact projection, and focused provider, trace-projection, availability, and auth-isolation checks validate the behavior.
